filing_event_lag_calendar_days.description: Filing date minus the cover-page event date; negative or missing dates yield missing, not a legal deadline assessment

header_reporter_count.description: Count of distinct observed header reporter CIKs, not validated economic managers

ownership_pct_valid_fraction.description: Valid percentages divided by extracted ownership rows for the matched security; no rows means missing

parsed_reporting_person_count.description: Number of parsed cover-page reporting persons; not independent investors or completeness certification

pre_disclosure_industry_sic2.description: Industry category from pre-disclosure SIC; 0 and 9999 are missing, and categories are not numerical magnitudes

prior_header_other_issuer_count_max.description: Maximum strictly prior other-issuer count among header CIKs; restricted history starts in 2013

prior_header_submission_count_max.description: Maximum strictly prior submission count among header CIKs; never summed across potentially related reporters

prior_issuer_other_reporter_count.description: Strictly prior reporter CIKs at this issuer outside the current header group; not evidence of continuing positions

reported_ownership_pct_max.description: Largest valid reported percentage for the uniquely matched security; not summed holdings or verified economic ownership

snapshot_security_market_cap_usd.description: CRSP dlycap times 1000 from the dated pre-disclosure benchmark snapshot; security-level, not consolidated company value

limits: Source hashes, citations, identifiers and chronology are checked; semantic extraction, vendor publication timing and economic manager identities are not certified. This covered sample has selective benchmark availability.
missing_rule: Keep null and source statuses; no imputation, scaling or dropping all incomplete rows during preparation. Learned transformations must be fitted separately within training folds.
ownership_rule: Use only rows for one security whose extracted CUSIP agrees with the frozen historical snapshot prefix. Otherwise ownership summaries are missing. Preserve each original row and evidence; never sum shares or percentages.
scope: Existing first-observed, single-filing, 504-session Russell-labelled development events
status: frozen feature-preview contract; not a model-fitting or trading protocol
target: Existing gross 504-session cumulative stock return minus assigned Russell ETF-proxy return, kept separately from features
